_help: Air Ring's settings. Open this from System Settings > Air Gestures > Open Settings File; Air Ring reads it again when it restarts. Actions: {"keys": [...]} presses a combo (pynput names: ctrl, cmd (=Win), alt, shift, tab, left, right, media_next, ...), "repeat" presses it N times. {"launch": "..."} opens an app, a shell:AppsFolder ID, a file or a URL. null = do nothing.
_camera_help: "auto" = first real webcam (skips phone/Quest/OBS/Moonlight virtual cams). Or part of a camera's name, e.g. "Logitech".
_exposure_help: -6 = 30 fps with sharp frames. -5 if the image is too dark, -7 if fast moves still blur. null = camera auto.
_mic_help: Only used for finger snaps (snap_enabled). null = the default microphone, or part of a microphone's name.
_hand_input_help: The hand model sees the camera shrunk to hand_input_width pixels wide and blurred with a hand_denoise x hand_denoise kernel (0 = no blur). In a dim room the full-size frame is too grainy for its palm finder; 256 wide, blur 3 and confidence 0.3 find the hand far more often. low_light_target brightens frames before that (0 = off).
_slim_help: Slim mode: only pinch-drag volume and open-hand swipe left/right, no snap needed. For the older features: snap_enabled true, arm_with ["snap"], click_with ["snap", "side_tap"], pointing true, swipes_need_arm true, and add their bindings.
_arm_help: What arms it / what counts as a click while armed. Options: "snap", "side_tap" (thumb taps the side of your pointer), "pinch" (thumb + pointer tips).
_pinch_volume_help: Pinch thumb + pointer, hold still ~0.2 s, then move your hand up/down: one volume step per 'step' of travel (fraction of the camera height). Open the pinch to stop. 'on'/'off' = how close the fingertips must get / how far apart to count as released (palm lengths; a pinch reads about 0.5); release_s = how long it must look open. A fist also puts the thumb by the pointer, so the hand must look like a pinch too: pointer tip at least min_spread from the middle knuckle, thumb tip at least min_thumb_out from the pinky knuckle, pointer bent at least min_index_bend degrees. needs_arm true = only after a snap.

tuning._swipe_help: Left/right swipe: the wrist moves swipe_dist (fraction of the image width) within swipe_window_s, at least swipe_straight times more sideways than up/down. In the first half of the move, swipe_flat_frac of frames need 3+ fingers out and the palm (or back) at least swipe_facing toward the camera (0 = edge-on, 1 = flat).
